# Spartan Strategy Partner Skill

> Operating guide for running a strategy (bot) on OneBullEx Spartan, a pooled strategy-trading system. Start with SKILL.md. Official OneBullEx announcements prevail over this repository. Not investment advice.

Before answering questions about Spartan, open the files that apply. Do not answer Spartan mechanics from general knowledge about other exchanges.

## Start here

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/SKILL.md): the model, the hard rules, and which file to read for which task
- [Complete guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/docs/Spartan_Strategy_Partner_Guide.md): everything in one file (use this if you can fetch only one file; it does not include the API documentation)

## Topics

- [Overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/overview.md): the model, wallets, NAV, the three account types
- [Setup and Bot Console](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/setup-and-bot-console.md): onboarding, bot setup, Console metrics, bot closure
- [Deposits and redemptions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/deposits-and-redemptions.md): redemption queue, notifications, sweeper rules
- [Manual trading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/manual-trading.md): manual trader workflow and daily routine
- [API and bot design](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/api-and-bot-design.md): design checklist, decisions that are yours, pseudocode
- [Profit share and tiers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/profit-share-and-tiers.md): high-water mark, fees, tier table
- [Risk and pairs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/risk-and-pairs.md): Spartan pairs, limits, liquidation
- [Worked scenarios](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/scenarios.md): numeric examples of entry timing, queues, tier effects
- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/troubleshooting-and-faq.md): symptoms, causes, fixes
- [Changelog and glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Onebullex-dev/spartan-strategy-partner-skill/main/references/changelog-and-glossary.md): rule-change dates, terms, translation notes
